BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: BE   SEMESTER: VII
BRANCH: MECH/PROD   SESSION : MO/2019

SUBJECT : EE3207 ELECTRICAL ENERGY GENERATION & CONTROL

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Q1 (a) What are different sources of energy and classify them? Explain why solar power plant is
used as base load plant.
[2]
 (b) Write a short note on Indian energy scenario and three major reasons behind  low per
capita energy consumption in India.
[3]


Q2 (a) Discuss the operation of thermal power plant using Rankine Cycle. [2]
 (b) Discuss with complete layout, the steam generating plant and its different components. [3]


Q3 (a) Discuss parallel flow Jet condenser with neat diagram. [2]
 (b) Explain with neat diagram the operation of steam condensing plant? [3]


Q4 (a) What is  cooling  tower?  What  are  the  functions of  forced  and  induced  draught  cooling
tower?
[2]
 (b) Explain cavitation problem in water turbine. Also discuss the functionality of surge tank
in hydro power projects.
[3]


Q5 (a) Illustrate the statement, “Hydro power projects are used as base as well as peak load
power plants.”
[2]
 (b) Discuss  the  construction  and  working  of  Pelton  wheel  turbine  used  in  hydro  power
projects.
[3]


Q6 (a) A 100 MW steam station uses coal of calorific value 6400 kcal/kg. Thermal efficiency of
the station is 30% and electrical efficiency is 92%. Calculate the heat produced per hour
and the average load when the station is delivering its full rated output.
[2]
 (b) Draw the layout of hydro power plant, classify them depending upon the head and explain
the working principle of each classification?
[3]

BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: BE   SEMESTER: III
BRANCH: EEE   SESSION : MO/2018

SUBJECT : EE3207 ELECTRICAL ENERGY GENERATION & CONTROL

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Q1 (a) What are the factors through which high diversity factor can be achieved?   [2]
 (b) There are three consumers of electricity having different load requirements at different
times. Consumer 1 has a maximum demand of 5 kW at 6 p.m. and a demand of 3kW at
7p.m. and a daily load factor of 20%. Consumer 2 has a maximum demand of 5 kW at
11a.m.,  a  load  of  2  kW  at  7p.m.  and  an  average  load  of  1200W.  Consumer  3  has  an
average  load  of  1kW  and  his  maximum  demand  is  3  kW  at  7p.m.  Determine  (a)  the
diversity  factor,  (b)  the  load  factor  and  average  load  of  each  consumer  and  (c)  the
average load and load factor of the combined load.
[3]

Q2 (a) What is power factor tariff? Classify them. [2]
 (b) An individual consumer has a maximum demand of 150 kW at load factor of 0.65. The
tariff is Rs. 900 per kVA of maximum demand per year plus Rs. 1.30 per kWh of energy
consumed.  If  the  average  power  factor  is  0.82  lagging,  calculate  the  total  energy
consumed per year and the total yearly electricity bill.
[3]

Q3 (a) What are base load and peak load power plants. Give proper reason for the classification. [2]
 (b) Explain  the  operation  of  thermal  power  plant  using  Rankine  Cycle considering  the
reheating effect.
[3]

Q4 (a) What are solar power towers? On what principle they are designed. [2]
 (b) Explain through proper diagram solar photovoltaic energy conversion. What factor should
be taken into consideration while selecting a solar panel as per its characteristic?
[3]

Q5 (a) What is balanced draught fan? Why is it superior over only ID Fan or only FD fan? [2]
 (b) Explain the working of Loeffler Boiler with proper diagram. Estimate its advantages over
Benson and La Mont Boilers.
[3]

Q6 (a) How are impulse and reaction turbines different? [2]
 (b) Analyze through proper diagram the compounding phenomenon of turbines in thermal
power plant.
[3]
